sections.heading: Sonipat's Estates: Kundli, Rai, Barhi and the Food Park
paragraphs: Sonipat's industry began in the 1950s with Atlas Cycles, and Wikipedia records Atlas, ECE and Osram among the early large units of the Sonepat industrial area. Today the district's industrial land is run by HSIIDC across estates at Sonepat city, Barhi, Kundli and Murthal, and HSIIDC's own list of specialist parks puts an unusual share of them in Sonipat: the Food Park at Rai, a Mega Food Park at Rai, the Export Promotion Industrial Park and the Electronic Hardware Technology Park at Kundli, and the Apparel Park at Barhi.

Kundli sits 1.6 km north of the Singhu border on the Delhi side of the district, which is why Delhi-based food companies that need a factory outside the capital so often end up here. The National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries established in 2012, is also at Kundli, so the district has the training and testing base for food plants as well as the land.

sections.heading: Yakult, Parag and the Dairy and Probiotic Plants at Rai and Sonipat
paragraphs: Two plants show what the Rai food belt actually makes. Yakult Danone India, a joint venture formed in 2005 between Yakult Honsha of Japan and Danone that launched its probiotic fermented milk drink in India in 2008, makes Yakult at a Sonipat factory that it reports is certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and HACCP. Parag Milk Foods, the Pune-based dairy company behind the Gowardhan and Go brands, bought Danone's Sonipat dairy factory in 2018 for Rs 30 crore after Danone closed its Indian dairy business, giving Parag its northern plant.

A probiotic drink is one of the hardest products to pipe. The product is a live culture that must be kept pure from fermentation to filling, the sugar and milk base is an ideal growth medium for anything else, and every batch is a culture that must not reach the next. Fermentation, inoculation, cultured-product transfer and the CIP return leg are therefore SF4 electropolished 316L, to ASME BPE surface designations, because a smoother passive bore gives stray organisms and biofilm less to anchor in and lets the CIP cycle prove the line clean.

sections.heading: SF1 or SF4 for Sonipat's Dairy and Food Lines
paragraphs: A conventional dairy, like the one Parag now runs at Sonipat, needs the electropolished finish selectively. Raw milk reception, chilled storage and plain pasteurised milk lines are cleaned daily by CIP and run well on SF1 mechanically polished 304L. The finish pays on cultured products, on evaporator concentrate and powder feed where protein bakes on, on flavoured and value-added lines where sugar and stabilisers cling, and on CIP return. Cheese brine, salted butter and hot CIP supply call for 316L rather than 304L because of chlorides at temperature.

For the snack, bakery and ready-to-eat units that fill a food park, the same rule applies: SF4 316L on product-contact, syrup, sauce and CIP-return lines, SF1 304L on treated water, chilled water and utilities. Where an ingredient or cleaning stream carries acid or chlorides at temperature, we quote 904L, which we supply electropolished. We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L.

sections.heading: Documents a Sonipat Food Auditor Will Ask For
paragraphs: Food plants in the Rai and Kundli estates work under FSSAI licences and the audits of their brand owners and export buyers, and the tube records belong in that file. Every heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis by a NABL-accredited laboratory. Each length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot has our internal Ra report so the finish can be matched to the line list. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

If your hygienic design review, equipment supplier or auditor asks for witness inspection, extra tests or a particular marking format on each length, include it in the enquiry and the quotation will price it in.

sections.heading: Sending a Sonipat RFQ
paragraphs: Quotations go out within 24 hours of a complete enquiry. For dairy, probiotic, food park or Kundli units, please tell us:
bullets: The product each line carries (raw or pasteurised milk, cultured or probiotic product, concentrate, snack or sauce, CIP) and whether you are the plant, a turnkey contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for fermentation, cultured product and CIP return; SF1 304L or 316L for plain milk and utilities; 904L electropolished for acid or chloride service.
Tube size and dimension series (SMS, DIN or ASME BPE inch), with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312, and the fittings they join to.
Inspection or audit documentation needed, and the plot address at Rai, Kundli, Barhi or Sonepat city.

sections.heading: Supplying Sonipat, Kundli and Rai from Mumbai
paragraphs: Material for Sonipat is sent by road from Mumbai, where we are located at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004. Every length travels with end caps and its heat number marked, and the quotation confirms the dispatch date and transit to your plant in writing.
